1:
SELECT *
FROM "eventspaces"
WHERE ("name" ILIKE '%banquet hall%' OR "name" ILIKE '%conference room%')
  AND "capacity" >= 200;
2:
SELECT id, name, capacity, address
FROM eventspaces
WHERE (name ILIKE '%banquet hall%' OR name ILIKE '%conference room%')
  AND capacity = 200;
3:
SELECT *
            FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT r."name", r."food_service"
                FROM "restaurants" r
WHERE LOWER(r."cuisine") LIKE '%italian%'
  AND (LOWER(r."food_service") LIKE '%restaurant%' OR LOWER(r."food_service") LIKE '%cafe%')
            ) sub
            ORDER BY r."food_service", r."name" ;
5:
SELECT DISTINCT r.*
FROM "restaurants" r
WHERE (r."food_service" ILIKE 'restaurant' OR r."food_service" ILIKE 'cafe')
  AND r."cuisine" ILIKE 'Italian';
6:
SELECT s."id", s."name", s."role", s."language"
FROM "staff" s
WHERE s."role" ILIKE '%chef%'
UNION
SELECT s."id", s."name", s."role", s."language"
FROM "staff" s
WHERE s."role" ILIKE '%server%' AND s."language" ILIKE '%english%'
ORDER BY "role", "name";
7:
SELECT DISTINCT s."id", s."name", s."role", s."language"
FROM "staff" s
WHERE (s."role" ILIKE '%chef%' OR s."role" ILIKE '%server%')
  AND s."language" ILIKE '%english%';
108:
SELECT DISTINCT mr."salary"
FROM "medicalroles" mr
WHERE mr."roleid" IN (
    SELECT hmr."roleid"
    FROM "hospitals_medical_roles" hmr
    GROUP BY hmr."roleid"
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT hmr."hospitalid") = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "hospitals")
);
109:
SELECT
    s."name" AS "specialist_name",
    sys."system_name" AS "system_name"
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" s
    JOIN "it_support_specialists_systems" iss ON s."id" = iss."it_specialist_id"
    JOIN "systems" sys ON iss."system_id" = sys."system_id"
ORDER BY
    s."name",
    sys."system_name";
110:
SELECT DISTINCT s."system_name", s."is_active"
FROM "systems" s
WHERE s."system_id" IN (
    SELECT iss."system_id"
    FROM "it_support_specialists_systems" iss
    GROUP BY iss."system_id"
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT iss."it_specialist_id") = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "it_support_specialists")
);
111:
SELECT 
    s."name" AS specialist_name,
    sys."system_name",
    sys."is_active"
FROM "it_support_specialists" s
JOIN "it_support_specialists_systems" iss ON s."id" = iss."it_specialist_id"
JOIN "systems" sys ON iss."system_id" = sys."system_id"
ORDER BY s."name";
112:
SELECT r."responsibility"
FROM "responsibilities" r
JOIN "internships_responsibilities" ir ON r."id" = ir."responsibilityid"
GROUP BY r."id", r."responsibility"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ir."internshipid") = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "internships");
115:
SELECT *
            FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT "i"."id" AS "internship_id",
    "i"."title" AS "internship_title",
    "r"."id" AS "responsibility_id",
    "r"."responsibility" AS "responsibility_text"
                FROM "internships" AS "i"
JOIN "internships_responsibilities" AS "ir" ON "i"."id" = "ir"."internshipid"
JOIN "responsibilities" AS "r" ON "r"."id" = "ir"."responsibilityid"
            ) sub
            ORDER BY "i"."id", "r"."id" ;
261:
SELECT "minimum_years", "preferred_years"
FROM "jobs"
ORDER BY "salary" DESC
LIMIT 1;
262:
SELECT DISTINCT sd."salary_range", sd."hourly_rate"
FROM "position" p
JOIN "salarydetails" sd ON p."id" = sd."positionid"
WHERE p."title" ILIKE '%software developer%' OR p."description" ILIKE '%software developer%';
